create_atoms_sequence_protocol: create a runtime checkable protocol that defines indexing and length for a sequence of Atoms objects
implement_atoms_dataset_sequence: implement a class that wraps an AseAtomsDataset to conform to the AtomsSequence protocol
index_atoms_by_integer: index an AtomsDatasetSequence with an integer to retrieve a single Atoms object from the dataset
get_dataset_length: get the length of an AtomsDatasetSequence by calling len on it to return the number of atoms
check_atoms_sequence_conformance: use isinstance to check at runtime if an object conforms to the AtomsSequence protocol
